inputs.96.text: Full-length documentary photograph, standing straight and facing the camera in a relaxed three-quarter view, head to boots in frame, against a plain warm-grey studio wall under soft even daylight. A sturdy 1940s aircraft factory worker woman in her late twenties, a broad round face with a wide nose, heavy dark eyebrows, a few freckles and a smudge of grease on one cheek, a confident lopsided grin, a red bandana with white polka dots tied over dark curly hair, navy-blue work coveralls with sleeves rolled up over strong forearms, welding goggles pushed up on her forehead, leather work gloves.
